column1: # Venus Lighthouse: the approach, scholars, soldiers, relief inscriptions and statue.

column3: Venus Lighthouse was...{pause_20_skippable}\nstruck by{pause_20_skippable} strangers...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nwho came without warning.{end_wait}

Iodem, rejoice{pause_20_skippable}. The way
into Venus Lighthouse
stands open...{page_break}After{pause_20_skippable} so many years...
our work has{pause_20_skippable} at last
borne fruit{pause_20_skippable}!{end_wait}
They attacked scholars...?\nWhat kind of people strike\nthose who cannot fight?{end_wait}
I waited years to see\ninside Venus Lighthouse.\nNow I can barely stand.{end_wait}
I can scarcely move.\nEvery breath sends pain\nthrough my body.{end_wait}
How... How did they\nopen the entrance to\nVenus Lighthouse?{end_wait}
They have already gone\nnorth toward Babi{pause_20_skippable}\nLighthouse...{end_wait}

Babi's guard is made
of Colosso champions...{page_break}Who could have defeated
all of us? What kind
of warriors were they?{end_wait}

Uhnnn... If only I could
stand again...{page_break}The lighthouse is open
at last, but{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} at what
cost?{end_wait}
Their powers were\nstrange beyond belief.\nWho were they?{end_wait}
I must enter{pause_20_skippable}\nVenus Lighthouse... I must\nlearn what lies within.{end_wait}
The boy began to shine\nfor a moment...{page_break}Then the entrance to\nVenus Lighthouse opened.{end_wait}

They did not remain
inside for long.{page_break}When I last saw them,
they were heading north
toward Babi Lighthouse.{end_wait}

One of them looked
familiar...{page_break}A scholar who worked
for Babi. Could it
have been Kraden?{end_wait}
Kraden begged them to\nstop, but they attacked.{page_break}They turned on scholars\nwithout a second thought.{end_wait}

Kraden entered, then
returned and said this
was not the way in.{page_break}But we searched every
corner. Where else
could an entrance be?{end_wait}

I planned to explore
once the door was open.{page_break}While I searched this
room, Kraden and the
others suddenly appeared.{end_wait}
They touched the statue.\nThen light spread across\nthe floor.{end_wait}
Without Kraden, we would\nhave been killed.{end_wait}
Kraden called this place\nthe exit...{page_break}What has he discovered?\nWhat does he know?{end_wait}

What secrets does the
statue conceal?{page_break}Kraden said it showed
the true path, but how
could stone reveal it?{end_wait}

Words have been cut
into the relief...{page_break}To climb Venus Lighthouse,
first awaken the power
that lies within.{page_break}Seek it with the eyes
that see beyond the
surface of things.{page_break}Yet this is not the
first step of the path.{page_break}Its true beginning lies
along ancient roads in
lands far from here.{end_wait}
Only one with a true\nheart can recognize\nthe road ahead.{end_wait}

The statue speaks to
{actor_name:1}'s soul...{page_break}You who seek the beacon,
I shall answer your wish.{page_break}The sealed path does
not begin here.{page_break}It begins far away,
on the land of an
ancient people,{page_break}where the sunrise lies
to your left as you
face the lighthouse.{end_wait}
The block will not move\nany farther.{end_wait}
